Hi Sara —

Sorry we missed you for today's discovery. I know schedules get tight; want to keep momentum and lock a short technical deep dive with engineering to walk through integration patterns and latency expectations. I can make any of these work (PT):

- Fri 2 Jul — 10:00–10:30am PT
- Mon 5 Jul — 9:00–9:30am PT
- Mon 5 Jul — 3:00–3:30pm PT

If you can confirm the best slot and who will join (I saw Mark was a suggested attendee), I'll send calendar invites and a tight 30-minute agenda. If we don't hear back in 36 hours we'll open the calendar to others to keep our pilot timelines on track.

I've attached our integration requirements checklist to help your eng team prep. Also copying Ben (solutions lead) in case you want a second engineering voice on the call.

Next steps (simple):
1) Reply with slot + attendee names OR
2) Propose a single alternate time in the next 72 hours

Thanks — really excited to show how Redwood can cut inference cost and stabilise latency for Lumina's search features.

—Connor
